# stackcone

> Custom software and AI development company — RAG chatbots, LLM integration, AI agents, full-stack web apps, Flutter mobile, data pipelines, and cloud DevOps. Remote-first delivery for teams worldwide.

## About

stackcone is a full-stack software and AI engineering studio with 10+ years experience, 30+ projects delivered, and 100% job success on Upwork. We work with startups and enterprise teams worldwide.

## Services

- Custom software development (web, APIs, dashboards)
- RAG chatbots and knowledge bases (vector search, embeddings, LLM integration)
- AI agents and workflow automation
- Full-stack web development (React, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, Node.js)
- Flutter mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Data engineering (ETL, streaming, warehouses)
- Cloud and DevOps (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
